timeline.prompt_video_minimax: Wide shot. The camera slowly pushes in as Sherezade walks alone down the dark corridor. Her expression is brave but tense. Flowing silk robes.
timeline.prompt_audio_minimax: [Foley] Slow footsteps on stone floor. [Ambient] Cold night wind howling outside. NO MUSIC.

timeline.prompt_video_minimax: Close up shot on Sherezade's face. The camera tracks backwards as she keeps walking. She takes a deep breath.
timeline.prompt_audio_minimax: [Foley] Fabric rustling, a deep nervous breath. NO MUSIC.

timeline.prompt_video_minimax: Medium shot. King Shahriar is sitting on the edge of his bed, looking down at his hands, brooding. Camera pans slowly to the right.
timeline.prompt_audio_minimax: [Foley] Heavy sigh. [Ambient] Fire crackling from the candles, warm room tone. NO MUSIC.

timeline.prompt_video_minimax: Over the shoulder shot from the King's perspective. Sherezade enters the room gracefully and bows her head.
timeline.prompt_audio_minimax: [Foley] Soft footsteps on Persian rug, fabric rustling. NO MUSIC.
timeline.texto_dialogo_limpio: Mi señor, he venido a acompañarte esta noche.

timeline.prompt_video_minimax: Close up on Sherezade. She looks directly at the camera with gentle, captivating eyes. Gentle flickering candle light on her face.
timeline.prompt_audio_minimax: [Speech] 'Hear me, my King, for the tale I bring tonight is unlike any other.' [Ambient] Soft fire crackling. NO MUSIC.
timeline.texto_dialogo_limpio: Escucha mi rey, pues la historia que traigo esta noche no se parece a ninguna otra.
